- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided details about the online Master of Science in Data Science (MSDS) at Johns Hopkins University, including:
  - Curriculum consists of 10 courses (30 credits) that can be completed in 2-3 years.
  - Courses include Introduction to Data Science, Statistical Computing and Graphics, Regression and Time Series, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Database Systems, Big Data Processing with Hadoop, Data Science Capstone I, Data Science Capstone II, and an elective.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted differences between the online and on-campus programs, including flexibility, delivery format, absence of a traditional practicum, limited elective selection, and different admissions requirements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant highlighted key benefits of the online MSDS program, including convenience, accessibility, prestige, and career support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information on admissions requirements and tuition for the online MSDS program, stating it costs around $53,000-$60,000 total.
